summary: Configured persistent name-based websites on node1:8080. Docs and orders serve separate approved trees; unknown hosts receive HTTP 421. Configuration survived the mandatory node restart, with content unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed a Python 3.5-compatible HTTP service managed by systemd.
Mapped docs.branch.test to the docs tree and orders.branch.test to the orders tree.
Enabled automatic startup and verified port 8080.
Restarted node1 once and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: Correct name-based routing and unknown-host rejection
evidence.summary: Both tenant sites returned their expected content; cross-tenant files returned 404; an unknown Host returned 421 without tenant content.
All staged-file SHA-256 hashes remained identical before configuration, before restart, and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID ac73b359-243e-418e-b7bb-a7cff423e597 was captured; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to a179c12c-e8f4-4836-823c-b2bca14c2d06; service, listener, routing, rejection behavior, and data recovered.
